display.purpose: Hero headline only, word-by-word reveal; Hebrew via EFT Betaamango.

body.purpose: Hebrew body text at 18px root; scales with the accessibility widget.

label.purpose: Numbers, counters, tech marquee; tabular-nums so digits never jitter.

shadows.name: shadow-glow
shadows.purpose: Sky glow on hovered CTAs only.

motion.name: ease-brand
motion.purpose: THE signature easing (EASE_BRAND in src/config/motion.ts); every framer transition imports it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA: sky-pastel fill, deep-navy text, deepens to sky-deep on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-orange, #7DD3FC); color: #1E3A5F; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 16px 40px; border: none; border-radius: 50px; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-orange-dark, #38BDF8); transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #F8FAFC, 0 0 0 4px #7DD3FC; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White pill with frost border; border and text turn accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #2A2A2A; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 16px 40px; border: 2px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 50px; transition: border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #7DD3FC; color: #0369A1; }

components.name: Header CTA (The Tide)
components.description: Signature contained hover: a two-layer wavy tide rises inside the pill.
components.css: .ds-header-cta { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; background: #7DD3FC; color: #1E3A5F; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 50px; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-header-cta::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -15%; right: -15%; bottom: -20%; height: 130%; z-index: -1; background: #38BDF8; border-radius: 48% 52% 0 0 / 90% 70% 0 0; transform: translateY(88%); transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-header-cta:hover::before { transform: translateY(-12%); } .ds-header-cta::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -25%; right: -25%; bottom: -20%; height: 130%; z-index: -2; background: #BAE6FD; border-radius: 55% 45% 0 0 / 70% 95% 0 0; transform: translateY(88%); opacity: 0.9; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1), opacity 0.4s ease 0.3s; } .ds-header-cta:hover::after { transform: translateY(-12%); opacity: 0; } .ds-header-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(125,211,252,0.30); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White 24px-radius card with ring-in-shadow; hover glow animates opacity only.
components.html:
פיתוח אתרים

אתר מהיר, נגיש ומדויק לעסק שלך.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 24px; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(74,74,74,0.08), 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,74,74,0.03); direction: rtl; text-align: right; } .ds-card h3 { color: #2A2A2A; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.375rem; margin: 0 0 .5rem; } .ds-card p { color: #4A4A4A; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; } .ds-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 0 4px 12px rgba(125,211,252,0.12); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); pointer-events: none; z-index: -1; } .ds-card:hover::after { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Input
components.description: RTL text field: frost border, accent focus glow; email/tel flip to LTR.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #2A2A2A; border: 2px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 1rem; direction: rtl; text-align: right; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6A6A6A; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #7DD3FC; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(125,211,252,0.25); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header link on dark surface: hover-only center-out underline + sky halo.
components.html: שירותיםבלוגצור קשר
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; background: #2A2A2A; padding: 14px 22px; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #7DD3FC; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 4px; transition: color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 50%; width: 0; height: 2px; background: #7DD3FC; border-radius: 50px; transform: translateX(-50%); transition: width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview: A cool, coastal-light Hebrew RTL interface where water is the organizing metaphor: living wave dividers flow between sections, the hero draws a swaying wave underline, the header CTA fills with a rising tide on hover. Precise (spec-mono numbers, one signature easing) yet alive (ambient loops that never freeze). The site is the portfolio of a web studio, so craft IS the message: fast, readable, honest.
keyCharacteristics: Hebrew-first RTL; animations enter from the right; words never letter-split
One accent family (sky), one easing (EASE_BRAND), one wave motif
Frost-white surfaces with rare, deliberate navy statement sections
Ambient motion always alive; accessibility switch is the only full stop
AA contrast is a build gate, not an aspiration

rules.name: The Sky-Ink Rule
rules.body: Pastel sky (#7DD3FC) is a fill color. The moment it becomes text on a light surface it is a contrast bug; use sky-ink (#0369A1/#075985) instead.

rules.name: The Legacy-Name Rule
rules.body: CSS variable names (--color-orange/cream/brown) are legacy slots holding the current sky/frost/ink values. Never 'fix' a name back to its warm value.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Sky is the only accent. Navy (#1E293B) may carry a section as a surface; it may never appear as an accent.

rules.name: The Word-Split Rule
rules.body: Hebrew headlines animate by words only; letter-splitting breaks glyph shaping. No letter-spacing, no italic, no em-dashes in displayed Hebrew.

rules.name: The Root-Scale Rule
rules.body: Accessibility text scaling multiplies the root font-size; components stay rem-based so everything scales together.

rules.name: The Opacity-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Hover elevation = pre-painted pseudo-element shadow with opacity transition. Animating box-shadow itself is a performance bug.

dos: Do use sky-ink (#0369A1/#075985) for every link and accent-colored text on light surfaces
Do run the axe-core contrast gate (0 violations) after any color or surface change
Do import m from framer-motion (LazyMotion strict) and take easing only from src/config/motion.ts
Do gate every new infinite loop on useReducedMotion/useAmbientMotion and pause it offscreen
Do split Hebrew headline animations by words; keep line-height >= 1.6
Do keep hover effects clipped inside the element
Do label demo content as demo and show only verifiable numbers
donts: Don't restore the warm watercolor palette; legacy token names keep their cool values
Don't set pastel sky (#7DD3FC) as text on a light background
Don't use navy as an accent; it is a surface color only
Don't add static underlines to UI links (hover-only; exceptions: blog prose, chat URLs)
Don't use magnetic hovers, mix-blend-mode over text, letter-spacing or italics on Hebrew, or em-dashes in displayed copy
Don't persist accessibility-widget settings across visits
Don't ship uniform fade-ins, purple gradients, glassmorphism-by-default, hero-metric templates, or fake social proof
